title: Garboh addat tan dahab tutucto
intro: taswiir fidin sacarah gasoh uddur qammaaliyyi kee asmat sinna. Kaxxa miraac Divine lih daffeynah gexeh yan, ayyunti addal geytimtah tan ximmooma elle geytimtah tan innal geytimtah tan. too rabbo sinni sooloh addat, geysis muuci maaqattooti fooca fan iffonta xagnittee kee agiirinni hadliyyi manol celta.
clues: Anu Muusa lih Masrik yewqeh yan marih fanat suge, bad ni kudah baxsimtem ubleh.
Anu ubleh ni mirac morootom bar qale gexe wak miracsenta geyuh.
Anu ummattak bila gaaboyseh inni gabat ken weeloyseh.
Anu addah tan xongolo tacee ruga bicseeh, sinam teetih seece.
Anu farmoyti gexok gabah agle beeh anu abeh aniimih addat qide.
Anu Muusa lih angaaraw luk sugeeh, 'touch yoo not' axcuk, baxsa luk, cokmih xagana culeh yan daffeynal, diggoyseh suge.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
